denialInfo.denialReason: Services not medically necessary as billed. Routine screening labs (CBC, CMP) are covered under the preventive benefit only when ordered as part of an Annual Wellness Visit (AWV) or USPSTF-aligned screening. Documentation submitted does not support a medically necessary diagnostic indication. Claim billed under non-preventive diagnosis codes (Z00.00, Z13.6) but services not linked to a documented clinical condition.
denialInfo.appealInstructions: Submit appeal with supporting clinical documentation (physician notes, clinical indication, prior results) to HealthBridge Appeals — PO Box 5500, Springfield IL 62708, or via Member Portal at HealthBridge.example.com/appeals within 90 days of denial date.

notes: Claim denied — routine labs billed under non-preventive codes without documented clinical indication. Member may appeal with clinical notes or resubmit under AWV encounter if applicable.
